verdict.rationale: No first-party doc in the pack names unattended access or preconfigured host credentials. Community reports do show it in practice: one user logs into a remote Windows PC with no one at the host after Wake-on-LAN, and others describe TeamViewer storing saved passwords so connections can be replayed. That points to the product's own unattended-access capability, but its depth is unproven. missing for 10: first-party documentation of unattended access setup, documentation of how credentials or passwords are preconfigured on the host, details on deploying unattended access at scale, independent confirmation that no host-side acceptance is needed.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set up unattended access to a machine with credentials configured in advance, so no one has to sit at the host to accept
